title: Sort artifacts by creation time when determining latest artifacts for release
summary: AL-Go now sorts artifacts by creation time when determining the latest artifacts for release in multi-project repositories, fixing cases where Create Release with app version latest could select artifacts from different CI/CD runs.
key_points: Artifacts are sorted by created_at descending instead of relying on endpoint order which could be by artifact ID
Resolves latest correctly to the same CI/CD run across all projects in multi-project repos
Improved error messages now include artifact name, project, and both commit hashes when commits mismatch
Regression test added to verify the fix handles artifacts returned out of chronological order
